reset_home.intent: 回到 iPhone 桌面，把手机恢复到已知起始状态
reset_home.notes: Recovery flow. Run this after any precondition_failed. Pure hotkeys, nothing to calibrate.

open_app_spotlight.intent: 按名字打开某个 iOS App（走 Spotlight 搜索，不依赖图标位置）
open_app_spotlight.notes: Postconditions intentionally empty — the caller knows what the app's first screen should show, this flow doesn't. APP must be ASCII/pinyin; step flows should use the engine's native open_app action, which handles Chinese via the clipboard.

jd_checkin.notes: UNVERIFIED — anchors written from the app's expected layout, never replayed on a real phone. Calibrate with screen_text.py before arming. 京东 moves the 签到 card between releases; fix the any_of strings in flows/jd_checkin.json, never add coordinates.

pdd_video_checkin.intent: 拼多多多多视频每日看视频打卡
pdd_video_checkin.notes: UNVERIFIED. Unlike the other two, this one idles WATCH_SECONDS watching video, so max_duration_s must stay well above WATCH_SECONDS + navigation or the deadline kills it before the postcondition runs. Raise both together.

futu_checkin.intent: 富途牛牛每日签到领牛币
futu_checkin.notes: UNVERIFIED. 富途 is a brokerage — the check-in itself only earns points, but trading, 下单 and 转账 live on the same navigation tree. The flow asserts screen_not_contains 买入/卖出/下单/委托 before each tap, on top of tap_text's global denylist. Do not relax either to make a broken run pass.
